overall: The AG found a secret-ballot vote on a special permit at the September 21, 2022 meeting violated the Open Meeting Law but was cured by reading the result aloud; no deliberation or minutes violation was found.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board deliberated about a special permit request outside its posted September 21, 2022 meeting, because no discussion followed the Chair's summary.
allegations.key_passage: Absent specific evidence to the contrary, we credit the Board’s version of events that it did not deliberate outside of the September 21, 2022, meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board voted by secret ballot on a special permit at its September 21, 2022 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law explicitly prohibits votes taken by secret ballot.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the September 21, 2022 minutes were inaccurate and insufficiently specific, omitting important statements by Board members.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the minutes adequately capture the substance of the discussions that occurred so that a member of the public who did not attend the meeting could read the minutes and have an understanding of what occurred.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law; similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
